Create a cataclysmic storm at the target location that builds for 2 seconds then lays waste to all enemies in the area, dealing [5955 / 6020 / 6086 / 6151] Magic Damage every 1 second for 7 seconds. Fiery Rage increases the damage by 15 %. Icy Rage immobilizes enemies hit for 3 seconds. Thunderous Rage increases the duration by 2 seconds.

Name: Eye of the Storm
Line Rank: The storm is cast above you instead, and follows you wherever you move. Target: Area. Create a cataclysmic storm above you that builds for 2 seconds then lays waste to all enemies nearby, dealing [4764 / 4816 / 4868 / 4921] Magic Damage every 1 second for 7 seconds.
